type_scope: package-local qualified names only; no global type record added. Receiver and Argument are both DECLARED AND LEFT UNDEFINED on purpose: the body never dereferences the receiver, and the argument it does dereference has no established type, so the sidecar asserts no size, layout, member or field for either.

original_native_abi.return_semantics: two exits of different shapes, and this field describes only the first. The early out at 0x00fa0003 returns, and its value IS the interior pointer the body formed at 0x00f9fef9: CMP EAX,EBX at 0x00f9ff0f is followed by JZ, so the branch is taken only when the slot-0x58 callee's answer equals EBX, and EBX is receiver+0x4 or zero. The main path does not return at all: it ends in the tail transfer JMP EAX at 0x00fa0001, so on that path the value the caller's caller receives is the tail callee's and nothing is returned by this body.

observed_original_abi.calling_convention_determination: C6B, on the receiver rule R1-VFT. Transcribed field for field from reconstruction/evidence/00f9fef0/evidence.json, category abi_derived: conventions.calling_convention = __thiscall, conventions.confidence = INFERRED, conventions.candidate_conventions = ["__thiscall"], conventions.ambiguities = [], conventions.corroboration = not_available, verdict ABI_INFERRED, conflicts [] empty. R1-VFT (INFERRED): "ECX carries the receiver" -- provenance vftable_slot_dispatch, so 0x00f9fef0 is a slot of a vptr-backed table and the body reads the register such a dispatch delivers. The register-carried value is read eleven times and that is the shape R1-VFT discriminates from the COM / __stdcall interface form, which takes its receiver from the first popped stack word and never reads its incoming ECX. C6B (INFERRED): "calling convention is __thiscall: the callee pops the stack arguments, which rules out cdecl and fastcall, and the receiver arrives in ECX". INFERRED, not OBSERVED: nothing in this repository has watched a caller dispatch through a table, and the record says so.
observed_original_abi.calling_convention_cleanup_confidence: OBSERVED, and independent of the convention: cleanup.evidence is "ret 0x4", the terminal immediate read straight out of the three bytes c2 04 00 at 0x00fa0006
observed_original_abi.conventions_note: The convention is recorded because the MACHINE determines it, not because this package chose it. The determination is transcribed field for field from the evidence pack's abi_derived category and carried in the staging header as DATA, where the model test checks every value against an independently written literal.
observed_original_abi.corroboration_of_the_determination: The two epilogues are the same three words, POP EDI / POP ESI / POP EBX at 0x00f9fff1..0x00f9fff3 and at 0x00fa0003..0x00fa0005, restoring the prologue's three pushes in reverse order; a stack-argument-cleaning thiscall is the reading under which that is coherent, and the terminator C2 04 00 says the callee pops them. The five direct callees' own terminators were read out of the image and agree with the shapes the listing enters them with: 0x006a25a0 is RET 0x4 and the body pushes one word for it; 0x00f96b40, 0x00f9e3a0, 0x0067dd80 and 0x0067ddd0 all end in a plain RET and none of them is given a pushed word. That is a second machine source and it does not depend on anything this package chose.
observed_original_abi.receiver: ECX carries the receiver, and the witness is the strongest in this campaign. 0x00f9fef3 MOV EDI,ECX copies the incoming register into EDI before anything else touches it; 0x00f9fef5 TEST EDI,EDI and 0x00f9fef7 JZ 0x00f9fefe NULL-TEST it; 0x00f9fef9 LEA EBX,[EDI+0x4] forms an interior address from it. What the machine record states, at INFERRED confidence: receiver {present true, register ECX, provenance vftable_slot_dispatch, bounds_only true, shape null, distinct_offsets 0, offsets [], written_through 0}. What the listing shows: the register is read by eleven instructions and every one of them uses EDI as a REGISTER -- MOV, TEST, LEA, MOV. Not one has EDI as a memory base. So ECX is NEVER DEREFERENCED and NO FIELD OFFSET IS CLAIMED IN EITHER DIRECTION: this package asserts neither a member at some displacement nor the object's being flat, empty or of any size. Receiver is declared and deliberately left undefined (`struct Receiver;`).
observed_original_abi.receiver_record: present: true, register: ECX, provenance: vftable_slot_dispatch, confidence: INFERRED, bounds_only: true, shape: null, distinct_offsets: 0, offsets: [], written_through: 0
observed_original_abi.receiver_alias: one copy only, MOV EDI,ECX at 0x00f9fef3, and it is dead from 0x00f9ffb4 (MOV EDI,EAX) onward: after that instruction EDI holds the slot-0x1c call's answer and is used as that object's register-carried value at 0x00f9ffc2 and 0x00f9ffd8. So the receiver copy's last use is the LEA at 0x00f9ff8a.
observed_original_abi.receiver_note: ECX is read at 0x00f9fef3 and is the receiver, per the machine record. The register is named here as an OBSERVED MECHANIC of the body and as the machine's DETERMINED receiver register; no package source names a class, a vtable identity, a receiver type, a field or an object size on the strength of it.
observed_original_abi.receiver_field_offset_statement: NOT CLAIMED, IN EITHER DIRECTION. The body shows no displacement through ECX or through the EDI copy of it, so nothing here asserts a member at any offset, and nothing here asserts the object's being flat, empty or of any size. bounds_only true with offsets [] is the record's own reading of exactly that absence, and this package restates it rather than filling it. The displacement 0x4 that the four LEAs carry is an interior ADDRESS, and nothing in these 281 bytes reads or writes the byte at receiver+0x4.
observed_original_abi.receiver_identity: UNRESOLVED, and not guessed. __thiscall says where the receiver arrives, not what it IS. This body neither dereferences nor adjusts the pointer, and this binary carries no MSVC RTTI (ghidra_function reports ghidra_has_calling_convention false and ghidra_calling_convention_signal "no_information" for this target). No class, no vtable identity, no receiver type and no object size is claimed.
observed_original_abi.receiver_where_the_receiver_is_not_claim: The record's vtable projection names one table for this address, vtable:0x01490be8, and the briefing lists eight same-subsystem analogues on the strength of that shared table. The single incoming code reference ghidra_function records for this VA is from 0x01490c74. Nothing here claims a class, a slot boundary, a virtual membership or a relationship to any of those analogues.
observed_original_abi.receiver_disambiguated_from_the_popped_w: The receiver (ECX) and the first callee-popped stack word at entry_ESP+0x4 are DIFFERENT values and this package keeps them apart, in the source, in the header, in the sidecar and in the model test. The stack word is ALSO an object pointer -- 0x00f9ff00 loads it into ESI, 0x00f9ff04 loads its first dword, and 0x00f9ff0b hands it in ECX to the virtual call at 0x00f9ff0d, and it is reloaded at 0x00f9ff5f, 0x00f9ff78, 0x00f9ff91 and 0x00f9ffb2, so it is dereferenced five times -- and it is STILL an explicit argument, not the receiver. The three reasons are separate and each is a fact of the listing: (1) it is a STACK slot and the receiver is a REGISTER, and the terminator pops exactly this one four-byte word and no more, so the popped area is one word wide and the receiver is not in it; (2) the body never dereferences the receiver at all, so a body that took its receiver from the stack would be a body that dereferences nothing, which is not this body; (3) the record's R1-VFT rests on the register the vtable dispatch that reaches slot 35 needed as its vtable base, and that is ECX. The model test drives the two over twelve distinct address pairs, fills the receiver run with a pattern that is not a dispatchable object so that a dispatch through the receiver would fault rather than quietly pass, and checks that the early-out answer tracks the receiver while the dispatch tracks the popped word.
observed_original_abi.ordinary_stack_argument_detail: entry_ESP+0x4, ordinal 1, sizes [4], at the offsets the record gives. The record marks it read: false and written: false; THE LISTING SAYS OTHERWISE ON BOTH COUNTS, and the divergence is reported rather than resolved -- see first_stack_argument_read, first_stack_argument_written and the abstention note below.
observed_original_abi.first_stack_argument_read_at: 0x00f9ff00, MOV ESI,dword ptr [ESP + 0x10] with the stack pointer at entry_ESP-12, so [ESP+0x10] is entry_ESP+0x4
observed_original_abi.first_stack_argument_written_at: 0x00f9fff4, MOV dword ptr [ESP + 0x4],0x0 with the stack pointer at entry_ESP, so [ESP+0x4] is entry_ESP+0x4 again; the value written is the constant zero. The SAME word is written a second time at 0x00f9ff38, MOV byte ptr [ESP + 0x14],AL with the stack pointer at entry_ESP-16, which is also entry_ESP+0x4 -- a one-byte store of the low byte of the second 0x006a25a0 answer, and 0x00f9ff46 then tests that same byte with CMP byte ptr [ESP + 0x10],0. The two stack-pointer values and the two displacements differ by the same four bytes in opposite directions, which is what identifies them as one byte, and neither figure depends on any unknown.
observed_original_abi.divergence_from_the_machine_record: The record's own abstention explains the divergence exactly and it is quoted here rather than paraphrased: abstained_because ["flow_not_modelled: the linear ESP walk ends at +60, so the listing is not one path"]. A linear ESP walk cannot see what a branch does to the stack pointer, so it walked the body straight through, ended at +60, and reported the slot's state from the terminal immediate alone (source ret_immediate). The record was NOT edited -- this package does not own that file -- and the divergence is carried here as an unresolved question. What the listing supports is carried as first_stack_argument_read and first_stack_argument_written, and the model test measures both: the READ by driving the reconstruction with two different words in that slot and observing which one the dispatch followed, and the WRITE by observing the zero the body leaves there from the tail callee's own argument.
observed_original_abi.stack_cleanup_evidence: ret 0x4, read from the bytes c2 04 00 at 0x00fa0006
observed_original_abi.return_width_basis: CMP EAX,EBX at 0x00f9ff0f is a four-byte compare and the early out's returned value is the same four-byte EBX, so the returned value on the returning path is 32 bits wide. The C spelling is a source-side choice; the machine fixes the register, the width and the pointer-shaped class (confidence INFERRED under RT1 and RT2) and not the spelling.
observed_original_abi.return_observation: The record classifies the return as pointer_like in EAX with aggregate_evidence bulk_write false, and the listing agrees on the width and the shape. The listing says more, and only the listing is read here: the early out returns the interior pointer, and the main path does not return at all. The C spelling is Word *, chosen because the value is a plain four-byte interior address; a pointer-to-Receiver spelling would additionally imply a type this package declines to name.
observed_original_abi.frame: four saved registers in all and no frame pointer. PUSH EBX, PUSH ESI and PUSH EDI at 0x00f9fef0..0x00f9fef2, restored by POP EDI, POP ESI and POP EBX in BOTH epilogues; PUSH EBP at 0x00f9ff17 is matched by POP EBP at 0x00f9ff3c. parse records push_ebp true, push_ebp_at 17, mov_ebp_esp false, fp false, sub null, local_extent 0, and the body allocates no frame of its own.
observed_original_abi.variadic: UNKNOWN (machine record; no variadic evidence either way)
observed_original_abi.tail_call: present. 0x00fa0001 JMP EAX is a tail transfer, not a call: the stack pointer is at entry_ESP there, so the callee's return address is this body's own return address, and its first stack argument is the zero written at 0x00f9fff4. The main path therefore never returns through this frame.
observed_original_abi.sret: present false; the return is a plain 4-byte value in EAX and nothing is written through a hidden pointer

observed_mechanics: MOV EDI,ECX at 0x00f9fef3 (bytes 8b f9): ModRM 0xf9 is mod=11 reg=111 (EDI) r/m=001 (ECX), so the incoming register-carried value is copied verbatim into EDI before anything else touches it. This is the receiver witness and it is the first instruction after the three pushes.

TEST EDI,EDI at 0x00f9fef5 and JZ 0x00f9fefe at 0x00f9fef7 (bytes 85 ff, 74 05): a null test of that copy, and the displacement 5 lands on the XOR EBX,EBX at 0x00f9fefe. A null receiver therefore produces a ZERO interior rather than receiver+0x4.

LEA EBX,[EDI + 0x4] at 0x00f9fef9 (bytes 8d 5f 04): forms an interior address and touches nothing. The same LEA appears at 0x00f9ff58 (8d 47 04), 0x00f9ff71 and 0x00f9ff8a, each guarded by its own TEST/JZ and an XOR EAX,EAX, and each result is only ever PUSHed as an argument or CMPared against a callee's answer. No byte at receiver+0x4 is read or written by this body.

CMP EAX,EBX at 0x00f9ff0f and JZ 0x00fa0003 at 0x00f9ff11 (bytes 3b c3, 0f 84 ec 00 00 00): the early-out test. The branch is TAKEN only when the slot-0x58 callee's answer EQUALS the interior pointer, so on that path the value this body returns IS that pointer -- receiver+0x4 for a non-null receiver, zero for a null one. That is a byte-level consequence of the compare-then-branch and not an inference.

MOV ESI,dword ptr [ESP + 0x10] at 0x00f9ff00 (bytes 8b 74 24 10): with the three prologue pushes and nothing else before it, the stack pointer is entry_ESP-12, so [ESP+0x10] is entry_ESP+0x4. This is the READ of the first callee-popped stack word, and the machine record's read: false for that slot is contradicted by these bytes.

MOV dword ptr [ESP + 0x4],0x0 at 0x00f9fff4 (bytes c7 44 24 04 00 00 00 00): with the three pops at 0x00f9fff1..0x00f9fff3 the stack pointer is entry_ESP, so [ESP+0x4] is entry_ESP+0x4. This is the WRITE of the same word, of the constant zero, and it is the last store the main path makes before it tail-transfers. The machine record's written: false for that slot is contradicted by these bytes.

MOV byte ptr [ESP + 0x14],AL at 0x00f9ff38 and CMP byte ptr [ESP + 0x10],0 at 0x00f9ff46 (bytes 88 44 24 14, 80 7c 24 10 00): the stack pointer is entry_ESP-16 at the first and entry_ESP-12 at the second, so the two displacements, which differ by four, and the two stack-pointer values, which differ by four in the other direction, name ONE byte -- entry_ESP+0x4. The body spills the low byte of the second 0x006a25a0 answer into its own first popped stack word and then branches on it, at 0x00f9ff4b, to decide whether 0x00f9e3a0 is reached. Only BL, not EAX, is what the earlier 0x00f9ff31 copy took.

Ten indirect transfers reach seven slot displacements: 0x58 once, 0x4c four times, and 0x1c, 0x13c, 0x134, 0x54 and 0xc once each. Nine are CALL EAX/EDX and the tenth, at 0x00fa0001, is JMP EAX. The machine dispatch record counts ten indirect transfers and the listing has ten, so the two machine sources agree and the listing is not a slice. The slot displacements are immediates out of MOV reg,[reg+slot] instructions; no class, no slot boundary and no vtable identity is claimed for any of them.

Six direct call sites reach five distinct callees: 0x006a25a0 twice (0x00f9ff25 and 0x00f9ff33), then 0x00f96b40, 0x00f9e3a0, 0x0067dd80 and 0x0067ddd0. Each one's terminator was read out of the image and matches the shape the listing enters it with: 0x006a25a0 ends in C2 04 00 and the body pushes one word for it; 0x00f96b40 (SUB ESP,0x8 / PUSH ESI ... POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x8 / C3), 0x00f9e3a0 (three pushes, three pops, C3), 0x0067dd80 (A1 CC D8 5F 01 / C3) and 0x0067ddd0 (A1 94 D8 5F 01 / C3) all end in a plain RET and none of them is given a pushed word.

MOV EBP,dword ptr [0x015fd918] at 0x00f9ff18 is the only data-segment operand in the 281 bytes. It is a four-byte LOAD: the word becomes the ECX of both 0x006a25a0 calls and is never written. What the word holds, and whether it is a pointer, is not established here.

The body is 281 bytes in total, 0x00f9fef0..0x00fa0008 inclusive, and the live read shows 0xCC inter-function padding behind it. All 112 instructions were checked against that byte string and consume it exactly, with nothing left over.

The receiver is read as a register eleven times and dereferenced zero times. The first callee-popped stack word is dereferenced five times. That asymmetry is the whole of the separation this package insists on between the two, and it is why the record's bounds_only true with an empty offsets list is restated rather than filled.

The calling convention is DETERMINED, not modelled: R1-VFT puts the receiver in ECX from the vftable-slot membership plus the incoming-ECX read, and C6B names __thiscall from the callee-side cleanup together with that register. Confidence is INFERRED, not OBSERVED. The five direct callees' terminators are a second, independent machine source that agrees.

unresolved_runtime_gates: no original-process trace exists in this repository for this target, so nothing here is a runtime claim
unresolved_questions: The machine record and the listing DISAGREE about the first callee-popped stack word: the record says read: false and written: false, and the listing reads it at 0x00f9ff00 and writes it at 0x00f9ff38 and 0x00f9fff4. The record's own abstention ("flow_not_modelled: the linear ESP walk ends at +60, so the listing is not one path") explains why, and the record was deliberately not edited, but the disagreement is real and is not resolved here. Which reading the game's own callers would confirm is an open question.

Is the first callee-popped stack word a parameter at all? It is established that the body reads it, dereferences it five times, spills a byte into it, tests that byte, and zeroes it before a tail transfer. Whether it is a declared parameter, and of what type and meaning, is not established by this listing and is not guessed.

What are the stack effects of the seven virtual callees? Their terminators are resolved at run time and are not in this image at this address, so the frame balance constrains only their sum. Many assignments close both epilogues and the tail transfer, so no per-callee figure is derivable here.

What do the immediates mean? 0x201a4e50 and 0xe13ce337 are passed as one 32-bit word each to 0x006a25a0, whose low byte return is the only part the body consumes; 0x7, 0x8 and 0x21 select the three consecutive slot-0x4c calls; 0x3fbae24 is passed to both the slot-0x1c and the slot-0x54 call; 0xa and 0x1 are passed to the slot-0x13c and slot-0x134 calls. The listing says which bytes are pushed and nothing about what they mean, and no meaning is claimed here.

Which class, if any, does this address belong to? R1-VFT establishes that it is a virtual member of SOME class, and that is as far as the evidence goes. This binary carries no MSVC RTTI, the record names no owning class, and identical folding means one address can be a virtual member of several classes at once, so no class identity is claimed.

What is at 0x015fd918, and is it a pointer? The body loads it and hands it to two 0x006a25a0 calls as the register-carried value, and never writes it, so it is read-only here; its type, its owner and its lifetime are not established.

What does 0x00f9e3a0 do with the receiver? It is entered with the receiver in ECX and its own body reads the receiver at +0x8d8 and +0x8dc, but that is a fact about 0x00f9e3a0 and NOT a field claim about this body's receiver: those offsets are inside a different function and are recorded here only so that a reader does not mistake them for this body's layout evidence.

focused_test.note: The test drives the reconstruction through its own declaration, so a defect in it cannot be papered over by a transcription, and it decodes the compiler's own emitted bytes at run time. The 281 image bytes are transcribed a second time in the TEST, independently of the header's transcription, and the two are compared position by position and both against the emitted code. Two classes of position cannot be compared numerically and each is named and bounded: the 28 relocatable bytes, which encode addresses in a different image and are required to resolve to the symbols the listing names, and the 42 bytes inside 21 register-only two-byte instructions that x86 spells two ways, where the MIRROR is computed from the image's own bytes (opcode minus two, ModRM reg and r/m exchanged, mod field required to be 11) so that no stored alternative can be edited to accept anything. Case H asserts the callee-side cleanup from the terminator's own three bytes rather than from a stack-pointer measurement, and the header comment records why: an earlier revision measured it with a hand-rolled indirect call that sampled the stack around the very epilogue under test, and a body four bytes off is indistinguishable in such an instrument from an instrument four bytes off.
